method: Read actual PDF-derived full body passages; visual checks resolve key scanned/overbarred statements. Full copyrighted sources and extracts remain only in ignored cache. Search snippets were discovery aids, never theorem evidence.

sources.title: Costabel, Stability analysis of the DDA for Dielectric Scattering, OWR 43/2022
sources.read_coverage: Printed pp. 2580–2582, complete contribution §§1–4 and references
sources.use_and_scope: Full original problem; same distributional A_kappa, off-diagonal sampled K_kappa and A_kappa-I/3 comparison. Static/dynamic stability results and observed nonreal spectral question. No condition (G) or necessary/sufficient geometry classification is printed.

sources.title: Costabel–Dauge–Nedaiasl, arXiv:2302.13159v3 (22 October 2023)
sources.read_coverage: §1.5.1 hypotheses (1.19),(1.21); §1.6 Theorem 1.6; §§2.1–2.4 Ewald proof and matrix extension; §3.5.1–2 Lemma 3.14 / Proposition 3.15 with proof; §3.5.4 numerical endpoint qualification; (1.7)
sources.use_and_scope: Load-bearing imported lattice boundedness/form bound, exact interval definition, continuum [-1/3,2/3] inclusion and normalization. Cubic homogeneous quadratic trace-free kernel; d=3 specialization matches K_0. Numeric endpoint extrema are suggested, not exact theorem values.

sources.title: Anselone–Palmer (1968), Pacific J. Math. 25, 423–431
sources.read_coverage: §§2–7, especially Proposition 3.1, Theorem 4.2, Theorem 5.3, Theorem 6.1, Proposition 6.3 and eigenvalue results
sources.use_and_scope: Historical abstract spectral machinery. Requires strong convergence plus collectively compact differences; raw static B_h is not shown to satisfy that global premise. The manuscript supplies a direct factorized compact-family argument.

sources.title: Anselone–Treuden (1985), Pacific J. Math. 120, 257–268
sources.read_coverage: Introduction and §§8–9, definitions and Theorems 8.1–8.5, 9.1; actual theorem 9.1 scanned page visually read
sources.text_locators: Text lines 1–70 and 305–471; PDF p12/printed267 image
sources.use_and_scope: Classical regular/collectively or asymptotically compact approximation and inverse stability. Theorem 9.1 is not an unconditional implication of strong convergence alone.

sources.title: Descloux–Nassif–Rappaz (1978), RAIRO 12, 97–112
sources.read_coverage: Introduction and §2, P1/P2, Lemmas 1–2 and Theorems 1–3 including finite-rank multiplicity consequence; §3 statement read for contrast
sources.use_and_scope: Historical spectral approximation credit. P1 restricted operator-norm approximation and P2 density differ from this manuscript’s raw B_h convergence. No direct application of DNR P1 to raw dipole matrices is assumed in this intake.

sources.title: Yurkin–Maltsev–Hoekstra (2006), JOSA A 23, 2578–2591
sources.read_coverage: §2.D assumptions and cubic Taylor cancellation; equations (64)–(70), especially explicit inverse assumption (65)–(66)
sources.use_and_scope: Prior DDA consistency/error analysis requires smooth bounded derivatives (through fourth order in this passage), fixed physical problem and inverse control. It is not an independently proven general off-interval norm-projection result in the passages read.

sources.title: Yurkin–Maltsev–Hoekstra (2015), JOSA A 32, 2407–2408
sources.use_and_scope: Erratum corrects weighted discretization and a sign; avoids silently comparing against an uncorrected formulation.

sources.title: Yurkin–Mishchenko (2018), Phys. Rev. A 97, 043824
sources.use_and_scope: Prior credit for pointwise center-value dependence and discussion of geometry/material continuity. The authors explicitly distinguish a uniform convergence hypothesis from its proof.

sources.title: Nedaiasl, Abel Visiting Scholarship report, visit 5 September–30 October 2022
sources.use_and_scope: Primary announcement of quasi-static and nonzero-frequency work and named time-harmonic manuscript in preparation; contains no full dynamic spectral theorem.

sources.title: Costabel, arXiv:2303.13693v2, finite Hilbert transformation
sources.read_coverage: Reference 3 and its surrounding reference context
sources.use_and_scope: Independent primary bibliographic evidence that named time-harmonic work was in preparation in 2023; no body of that work is supplied.
